recording.title: Happy Birthday — complete piano-style instrumental
recording.creator: Created for Birthday World
recording.source: Original local instrumental arrangement and synthesis of the familiar Happy Birthday melody. No voice or downloaded recording is used.
recording.changes: Complete 24-beat melody with soft accompaniment and a short stereo room tail; loudness normalization and MP3 encoding. Begins at birthday-room entry and repeats through the ending until replay.
recording.reviewStatus: Full score and media decoding verified. Speaker listening is left to the user.

soundDesign.creator: Original synthesis for Birthday World
soundDesign.description: Room/breeze beds, sparse birdlike tones, ribbon/paper movement, layered door latch/wood/settle effects, candle puff and warm harmonic cues are generated locally by audio.ts. Applause and fairy-dust shimmer use the separately credited recordings below.

effects.title: Small applause
effects.creator: Breviceps
effects.changes: Light compression and peak limiting for audibility, short entrance and closing fades; stereo MP3 encoding.

effects.title: Magic Wand Glitter
effects.creator: qubodup
effects.changes: Natural recorded chime variants overlapped into a continuous 11-second shimmer with 60ms edge fades. Playback volume follows the particle animation; no third-party request is needed at runtime.
